lineage.description: IOM DTM conducts periodic site assessments of IDP settlements in CAR using standardized methodology to enumerate displaced populations and document their characteristics and needs. Data are collected through field teams visiting displacement sites and aggregated at site level across multiple assessment rounds.

sources.name: International Organization for Migration (IOM)
sources.description: IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) provides site-level enumeration of internally displaced persons through standardized assessment methodology across multiple rounds.

resources.title: DTM CAR Site Assessment Round 8
resources.description: Data collected from 05 May to 10 July 2019 in 1,426 localities in 9 prefectures (Bamingui-Bangoran, Bangui, Lower Kotto, Upper Kotto, Haut-Mbomou, Mbomou, Nana-Gribizi, Ouaka, and Ouham Pendé) from RCA. During the DTM assessments, a total of 1,401,261 IDPs were identified, including 537,285 internally displaced persons (26 per cent more than the previous round), 600,479 returnees (former IDPs) (32 % more than the previous round) and 263,497 people returned from abroad (102% more than the previous round).
